method: Original-resolution image inspection of all three figures plus per-page text extraction of the ten-page Word-rendered PDF. Limitation: no page-image contact sheet in this environment (LibreOffice renderer unavailable; PDF produced via Microsoft Word automation).

figures.story: Show why the work moved from a real test case through modal updating, response evaluation, and model-form edits
figures.manual_note: Unchanged design from the v1 brief, regenerated from the same code path.

figures.story: Six held-out channels ranked best to worst by a preregistered rule: the update is calibrated by widening, not by repairing every FRF
figures.manual_note: Selected DAQs 28, 79, 9, 56, 2, 24 at preregistered ranks 1, 7, 13, 19, 25, 31 (rule fixed in decisions_log.md F2 before plotting). First render had caption overlapping x-axis labels; margins fixed and re-inspected clean. DAQ 24 falls out as worst-ranked, consistent with the v1 two-panel figure.

figures.story: The modal data learn four combinations and retain a 4.2-4.8% residual floor (appendix detail)
figures.manual_note: Same design as the v1 fig2, now placed in Appendix A. The 'prior-like' label sits close to the direction-8 marker, as in v1; still legible. Non-converged variants use hollow markers with worst R-hat/ESS printed.

pagination_check: Per-page text extraction confirms one section per page across 10 pages: masthead/overview, definitions+likelihood inventory, modal answers, response experiments ledger, working-twin figure, load comparison + expanded evidence, remodeling, closing + guidance, appendix A/B, references.
